lines.trans: Xingzi instructed me to make sure the patient takes his medicine.
Honestly, there is no need to stay past quitting time every single day without going home.
It is not every day—just these few days.
Are we not in a critical period right now?
Did the chairwoman call you in about the revamp proposal? Did it go smoothly?
Right now the pushback is very strong.
Is it because the proposal I drafted was too hasty?
I was the one who put your proposal on the table; are you saying I was too hasty?
No, not at all—I did not mean that; how could I?
No matter what, other people may underestimate you and put you down.
Yet you yourself must never talk about yourself like that.
